title: Blucon Nightrider sync with 2 xdrip devices???
symptom: My wife changed her phone and installed xDrip on it. She is unable to sync her Blucon Nightrider with her new phone, but she can with her old phone.
cause: The thread implies that the Blucon Nightrider cannot sync with two smartphones simultaneously; it needs to be unpaired from the old phone.
fix: Under System Status menu, use 'Forget Device' to unpair the old smartphone.
evidence_quote: Yes, You need to "Forget Device" under System Status menu.
